text:
Devin (sales): Kicking off EdgeCore POC load test — need confirmed load plan + a quick pricing delta for the burst profile. Customer expects 250 rps sustained, quick spikes to ~3k rps for ~30s, and p95 < 200ms. Can eng validate infra footprint and a run schedule? @Maya :wave:
Maya (eng): Got it. A couple quick Qs: which model variant are they testing, avg prompt + gen tokens, and do they require streaming? Also do we need prefix/KV cache turned on for this test?
Devin (sales): They want to try the gptx-small-open baseline (we'll map to redwood-4-sim for hosted perf), avg prompt ~120 tokens, generation ~200 tokens. Streaming disabled. They said caching is fine if it mirrors prod.
Alex (solutions): Plan suggestion — run a 30m ramp: 0 -> 250 rps (5m warmup), hold 250 rps for 15m, then 3 burst pulses: 30s at 3k rps spaced 5m apart, ramp down 5m. Measure p50/p95/p99 and tail for each phase. Use sustained concurrency tests + short high-rate bursts. Example vegeta command for sustained:
```bash
vegeta attack -rate=250 -duration=15m -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report -type=json > sustain-report.json
```
For the bursts use:
```bash
vegeta attack -rate=3000 -duration=30s -targets=targets-burst.txt | vegeta report
```
Prefix caching: enable prefix-KV and a small 30s cache TTL to reflect prod.
Maya (eng): That plan works. Notes on infra: with redwood-4-sim quantized on A100-ish nodes, rough sizing is: 4 nodes to handle 250 rps steady with batching tuned (batch window 20ms), and ~6 nodes to handle the 3k bursts if autoscale can spin up in <90s. If autoscale can't hit that, we'll need a reserved burst pool (hot standby). Also enable request-level timeouts at 5s to protect queues.
Jordan (finance): Back-of-envelope cost: baseline (4 nodes) ~= $14k/month hosted reserved. Adding a hot-burst pool to comfortably absorb 3k spikes (6 node equivalent on standby) adds ~+$3k/month. If customer signs a 12-month commit we can reduce to ~$9k/mo baseline and ~$2k for burst. These are high-level — will run a detailed calc once Maya confirms actual instance types and expected token/sec.
Priya (sec): Couple enterprise/security blockers to flag: customer requires VPC peering + cross-account VPC routing, HSM-backed key management for model input/output encryption, SOC2 + HIPAA attestation, and 1yr audit log retention. Also need SCIM for SSO. Please add these to the security questionnaire before the exec review.
Devin (sales): Thanks — customer already sent the security questionnaire link: https://vendor.example.com/edgecore/sec-q. I'll upload after Priya and Alex confirm answers. Maya — can you produce the test artifacts (targets files, config, and a short runbook) by EOD tomorrow?
redwood-deploy-bot: Scheduled loadrun #ec-poc-2339 for 2026-03-22T22:00Z — runners reserved (4->6 autoscale).
Maya (eng): I created the runbook draft and targets. Short snippet of header we plan to use:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-4-sim",
  "prompt_tokens_avg": 120,
  "completion_tokens_avg": 200,
  "streaming": false,
  "cache": { "prefix_kv": true, "ttl_seconds": 30 }
}
```
I'll attach full targets.txt and vegeta scripts to the GH gist after tests. Running warmup tomorrow at 22:00Z; expect first burst at +20m. Measuring per-route latency, token throughput, and error rates.
Alex (solutions): Please include token-level cost breakdown (tokens/sec * price) in the final report and call out quantization delta. Also note that enabling prefix cache will reduce token count vs cold path by ~15-25% for this workload.
Priya (sec): I'll start drafting the security questionnaire answers. On HSM: we need to confirm whether they require customer-managed HSM (we support via KMS/HSM integrations) or just KMS. If customer insists on on-prem HSM then Private deployment talk needed.
Devin (sales): Noted — I'll push that distinction in the exec call. Last ask: can eng produce a short post-run summary within 24h of the test? Customer expects numbers quickly.
Maya (eng): Yep — will produce a 24h run summary with p50/p95/p99, sustained throughput, burst tail-latency, error counts, and a recommended autoscale/reserved-burst config. Marking for signoff: @Jordan for pricing, @Priya for sec answers.
Alex (solutions): +1 from me. :thumbsup:
Devin (sales): Great — thanks everyone. I'll loop customer in once we have the runbook and sec answers.
